name: Answering a question advances the progress counter
description: Selecting an answer on the Solstice take page advances the question counter from 1 to 2. (The progress-bar-width comparison was removed: the checker cannot verify a relative before/after size change.)

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Verify the progress indicator reads '1 of 36'.
Click the numbered answer option 4 for the first question
Verify the progress indicator reads '2 of 36'.
